faqs.a:
(a)
Tag to be worn.
Every owner or custodian shall maintain upon each dog or cat collar or harness to
               which its current rabies tag shall be attached.
(b)
Tag not transferable.
No person shall affix to the collar or harness of any dog or cat, or permit to remain
               affixed, a tag evidencing inoculation for any other animal, or display any such tag
               to an animal management officer or peace officer.
(
Ord. No. 4060, § 2, 3-19-2007
)
